final: WITH major_counts AS (SELECT link_to_major, COUNT(*) AS member_count FROM member GROUP BY link_to_major), totals AS (SELECT SUM(member_count) AS total_count, AVG(member_count) AS average_count FROM major_counts) SELECT mc.link_to_major, mc.member_count, CAST(mc.member_count AS REAL) / t.total_count, CAST(mc.member_count AS REAL) / t.average_count FROM major_counts AS mc CROSS JOIN totals AS t WHERE t.total_count IS NOT NULL AND t.average_count IS NOT NULL ORDER BY CAST(mc.member_count AS REAL) / t.average_count DESC LIMIT 10
